reviews.text: Cleo is a very kind person and it's clear she loves animals. Trufa had a wonderful time at her home. She also kept me updated and sent me photos daily. I will definitely use her services again when I travel. :)

I'm thrilled with the care Lucas has received. ❤️ You can see the love, dedication, and attention he's received, and that gives me so much peace of mind. He's been in excellent hands, and I couldn't be more grateful for how well he's been cared for. I would definitely repeat the experience and recommend them 100%. Thank you so much for taking such good care of Lucas! 🐶💕

We had an emergency and I contacted her, and I couldn't have asked for better treatment for my dog. He's a very shy dog ​​and sometimes gets very nervous, but she treated him wonderfully and he came home very happy. We'll definitely be back!
Excellent caregiver. She inspires confidence in the animals. Highly recommended.
Fantastic caregiver, highly recommended. We felt completely at ease while Nala was with her; she kept us informed. A truly lovely and friendly woman. So happy!! 😊 Thank you so much 😊

It was a wonderful experience.

Excellent experience with my dog. Cleo took great care of him, took him for walks, and kept me informed the whole time. I will definitely use her services again when I return to Valencia.

We are very happy with the care Cleo gave our chihuahua. She gave us a lot of confidence and kept us updated with videos and photos every step of the way!
We definitely recommend her.

We left our dog Piña with Cleo for three weeks, and she was an exceptional caregiver. Piña suffers from separation anxiety, and Cleo made him incredibly happy and comfortable from day one. Piña formed a wonderful bond with Cleo, which gives us peace of mind about leaving him with her in the future.
Very professional. Serious and trustworthy. Our dog was calm and returned to us in perfect condition. It's clear she enjoys working with pets in a friendly, family setting.
